project.title: Fungal communities in urban park soils from Shanghai
project.description: Our main aim was to identify major driving factors that structure fungal communities in urban park soils, and their relative importance in determining microbial community assemblages.
project.center_name: Shanghai Academy of Landscape Architecture Science and Planning
